positions.summary_short: Creelman calls for careful budgeting and new revenue sources as provincial grants shrink and fixed costs rise.
summary_bullets: Notes almost 50% of taxes go to Dufferin County programs, ~25% of expenditures to OPP/fire services, and over 50% of the budget to roads.
Provincial grants declined by $664,432 over four years while insurance costs rose double digits; calls for careful budgeting, in-year savings and new revenue sources beyond property taxes.
positions.verbatim_quote: We must always balance spending with what we can afford.
positions.source_title: johncreelman.com — campaign issues

positions.summary_short: Creelman rejects Strong Mayor Powers for Mono as anti-democratic and wants every candidate on record.
summary_bullets: Opposes provincial Strong Mayor Powers for Mono, calling them anti-democratic and corrosive to collaborative council decision-making.
Says every candidate in the election should be asked where they stand on Strong Mayor Powers.
positions.verbatim_quote: We don’t need them, and I don’t want them.
positions.source_title: johncreelman.com — campaign issues

positions.summary_short: Creelman wants an overdue Official Plan and zoning review, fast action on monster homes and light pollution, and a streamlined approvals process.
summary_bullets: Says a review of Mono's Official Plan and Zoning By-law is overdue; some changes, including oversized 'Monster Homes' and light pollution, should not wait for a full review.
Favours streamlining the planning application process to reduce wait times and eliminate red tape.
positions.verbatim_quote: A review of Mono’s Official Plan and Zoning By-law is overdue.
positions.source_title: johncreelman.com — campaign issues

positions.summary_short: Creelman calls for better-maintained Mono roads and county investment in Hockley, Mono Centre and Airport Roads.
summary_bullets: Wants Mono roads maintained in good repair and Dufferin County to invest in repairs to Hockley, Mono Centre and Airport Roads.
Says repair needs in many locations are badly overdue.
positions.verbatim_quote: In many locations, this is badly needed.
positions.source_title: johncreelman.com — campaign issues

positions.summary_short: Creelman wants effective policing, higher fines for driving infractions and targeted road-safety work as OPP costs climb.
summary_bullets: Says OPP costs are projected to rise as much as 11% next year, on top of 11% last year and a 22% increase in 2025.
Calls for effective policing, increased fines for driving infractions, and targeted road safety initiatives in areas of concern.
positions.verbatim_quote: For years now, I have called for effective policing and an increase in fines for driving infractions.
positions.source_title: johncreelman.com — campaign issues

positions.summary_short: Creelman demands a provincial wildfire plan for Mono's parks and county forest lands.
summary_bullets: Wants the Province to develop a comprehensive fire plan for Mono Cliffs Provincial Park, Hockley Valley Provincial Nature Reserve and Dufferin County Forest.
Says relying on local fire departments and mutual aid in the event of a wildfire 'isn't good enough'.
positions.verbatim_quote: What we do not have from the Province is a comprehensive fire plan for its large tracts of land.
positions.source_title: johncreelman.com — campaign issues

positions.summary_short: Creelman proposes a revived community litter-pickup day and stronger action on invasive species.
summary_bullets: Wants to restore a 'Make Mono Shine' litter pickup day, including garbage tags for residents who regularly clean side roads and parks, plus extended brush drop-off at the landfill after ice-storm damage.
Calls for more public education and partnerships with Parks Ontario, conservation authorities and landowners on invasive species (Phragmites, Buckthorn, Dog-strangling vine).
positions.verbatim_quote: Sadly, litter and garbage along our roads and in our parks are increasing.
positions.source_title: johncreelman.com — campaign issues

positions.summary_short: Creelman backs tougher by-law enforcement via an administrative penalties system for illegal land uses.
summary_bullets: Proud of progress cleaning up junk sites and illegal truck yards; says the Town must prepare for more illegal land use.
Supports transitioning to an Administrative Penalties process (pending provincial approval) so fines can be set and collected efficiently.
Wants faster, more responsive follow-up when residents report by-law breaches.
positions.verbatim_quote: We must prepare for more illegal land use in the future.
positions.source_title: johncreelman.com — campaign issues

positions.summary_short: Davie pledges careful stewardship of tax dollars with full lifecycle costing of projects.
summary_bullets: Priority: 'Safeguard our finances' — treat taxpayers' money with care.
Decisions should recognize the full cost of projects, including ongoing maintenance and lifecycle costs.
positions.verbatim_quote: Treat taxpayers’ money with care and make decisions that recognize the full cost of projects, including ongoing maintenance and lifecycle costs.
positions.source_title: Home | Melinda Davie - Mayor of Mono

positions.summary_short: Davie commits to maintaining essential municipal services in a sustainable, affordable way.
summary_bullets: Priority: 'Protect our services' — maintain the essential municipal services residents rely on.
Services must remain sustainable and affordable over the long term.
positions.verbatim_quote: Maintain the essential municipal services residents rely on, while ensuring they remain sustainable and affordable over the long term.
positions.source_title: Home | Melinda Davie - Mayor of Mono

positions.summary_short: Davie calls for thoughtful decisions on infrastructure, growth and development balancing present needs and future costs.
summary_bullets: Priority: 'Plan for our future' — thoughtful decisions about infrastructure, growth and development.
Weighs both today's needs and tomorrow's costs.
positions.verbatim_quote: Make thoughtful decisions about infrastructure, growth and development, with an eye to both today’s needs and tomorrow’s costs.
positions.source_title: Home | Melinda Davie - Mayor of Mono

positions.summary_short: Davie promises independent, practical leadership that serves all of Mono.
summary_bullets: Pledges to represent all of Mono: listen to different perspectives and decide based on what is best for the whole community.
Slogan: 'Practical Leadership. Sound Decisions. Mono First.'
positions.verbatim_quote: As Mayor, I will work for the whole community
positions.source_title: Home | Melinda Davie - Mayor of Mono

positions.summary_short: Campbell centres her campaign on protecting Mono's water, farmland and rural heritage, including opposing data centres.
summary_bullets: Pledges to protect Mono's water, farmland, rural heritage and trails.
Notes Mono challenged a development at the Ontario Land Tribunal over an unsatisfactory water-supply plan; cites pumping-station, arsenic and septic-quality issues.
Will advocate against data centres across Dufferin County because of their land and water demands.
positions.verbatim_quote: Protect our water, farmland, rural heritage and trails
positions.source_title: Laura for Mono — Deputy Mayor Candidate

positions.summary_short: Campbell supports affordable housing strategies sited in Orangeville to avoid straining Mono's water.
summary_bullets: Acknowledges a crucial need for affordable housing in Dufferin County.
Would work with County Council and staff to promote creative housing strategies within neighbouring Orangeville that do not strain Mono or Orangeville water sources.
positions.verbatim_quote: While there is a crucial need for affordable housing in Dufferin County
positions.source_title: Laura for Mono — Deputy Mayor Candidate

positions.summary_short: Campbell promises accountable budgeting, new revenue streams and transparent spending communication.
summary_bullets: Small business owner with 15 years' experience; promises responsible spending aligned with core needs.
Seek new revenue streams and every remaining provincial grant; ensure continued transparency and public engagement on budget issues, including town-level social media updates.
positions.verbatim_quote: Keeping your tax dollars accountable
positions.source_title: Laura for Mono — Deputy Mayor Candidate

positions.summary_short: Campbell wants a stronger recreation plan and more low-cost community programming using Mono's facilities and trails.
summary_bullets: Says Mono's recreational plan needs more attention; wants to support volunteer networks maintaining forest tracts and trails (Bruce Trail network, Mono Cliffs Provincial Park).
Wants to explore no-to-low cost community activities at the Mono Centre community centre and Monora Park pavilion.
positions.verbatim_quote: Our recreational plan needs some more attention.
positions.source_title: Laura for Mono — Deputy Mayor Candidate

positions.summary_short: Campbell promises to advocate for Mono at Dufferin County and protect vital county services.
summary_bullets: Pledges to champion Mono's voice at the County table.
Supports expanding efforts to keep vital county services (long-term care, mental health, housing) resilient so nobody is left behind.
positions.verbatim_quote: Champion Mono’s voice at the County Table
positions.source_title: Laura for Mono — Deputy Mayor Candidate

positions.summary_short: Mayer-Harman pledges responsible spending focused on municipal fundamentals beyond the next budget.
summary_bullets: Platform: Responsible Spending & Taxes — focus on the fundamentals, respect taxpayers, plan beyond the next budget.
Believes every tax dollar and hour of staff time should deliver measurable value.
positions.verbatim_quote: Good local government begins by listening. Mono Council should focus on its core responsibilities, treat every resident fairly and ensure every tax dollar and hour of staff time delivers value we can measure.
positions.source_title: Vote Brad Mayer-Harman for Mono Council

positions.summary_short: Mayer-Harman promises safe, well-maintained roads with early fixes.
summary_bullets: Platform: Safe, Well-Maintained Roads — maintain what Mono has and fix problems before they become more expensive.
Takes road safety concerns seriously.
positions.verbatim_quote: Maintain what we have. Fix problems before they become more expensive. Take road safety concerns seriously.
positions.source_title: Vote Brad Mayer-Harman for Mono Council

positions.summary_short: Mayer-Harman pledges to protect Mono's land, water and rural character.
summary_bullets: Platform: Protecting Mono's Environment — the land, water and rural character that make Mono special.
Believes growth and change should be managed with residents, not imposed on them.
positions.verbatim_quote: Protecting what we love. Planning for what comes next.
positions.source_title: Vote Brad Mayer-Harman for Mono Council

positions.summary_short: Mayer-Harman supports thoughtful, resident-led planning for growth.
summary_bullets: Platform: Thoughtful Planning & Responsible Growth — planning for change without losing what makes Mono, Mono.
Growth and change should be managed with residents — not imposed on them.
positions.verbatim_quote: He believes growth and change should be managed with residents — not imposed on them
positions.source_title: Vote Brad Mayer-Harman for Mono Council

positions.summary_short: Mayer-Harman promises accessible, listening-first representation for every part of Mono.
summary_bullets: Platform: A Voice for Every Part of Mono — listen first, communicate clearly, be accessible.
Promises to do the homework, listen before deciding, and explain decisions openly.
positions.verbatim_quote: Listen first. Communicate clearly. Be accessible.
positions.source_title: Vote Brad Mayer-Harman for Mono Council

positions.summary_short: Mayer-Harman calls for reliable rural internet and cell reception.
summary_bullets: Platform: Preparing Mono for What's Next — modern infrastructure, reliable connectivity, a municipality prepared for a changing world.
Specifically names reliable internet and cell reception.
positions.verbatim_quote: Preparing Mono for what’s next, including reliable internet and cell reception.
positions.source_title: Vote Brad Mayer-Harman for Mono Council

positions.summary_short: Sinclair pledges to protect Mono's water and oppose proposals threatening aquifers.
summary_bullets: Pledges to fight to protect Mono's water, people and environment.
Will oppose proposals that would jeopardize aquifers, well-being and property values; as part of the Headwaters, careful protection of waters is critical.
positions.verbatim_quote: I will fight to protect our water, our people, and our environment.
positions.source_title: christine sinclair for mono council – Sustainable Stewardship for Mono

positions.summary_short: Sinclair wants planning that protects farmland and supports farmers.
summary_bullets: Says sustainability and inclusion must be a cornerstone in planning.
That approach protects farmlands and supports Mono's farmers.
positions.verbatim_quote: This protects our farmlands and supports our farmers.
positions.source_title: christine sinclair for mono council – Sustainable Stewardship for Mono

positions.summary_short: Sinclair promises maintained roads, cared-for parks and neighbour-focused service.
summary_bullets: Pledges to listen to residents and maintain roads, take care of parks and neighbours.
Frames herself as a careful steward creating long-term solutions.
positions.verbatim_quote: maintaining our roads, taking care of our parks and our neighbours.
positions.source_title: christine sinclair for mono council – Sustainable Stewardship for Mono

positions.summary_short: Sinclair promises careful spending and alternative municipal funding sources beyond taxes.
summary_bullets: Promises to be careful with tax dollars: discern need-to-have from nice-to-have while keeping foundations strong.
Will look for alternate sources of municipal funding rather than always billing taxpayers.
positions.verbatim_quote: It doesn’t always have to be taxpayers that foot the bill.
positions.source_title: christine sinclair for mono council – Sustainable Stewardship for Mono
